definitions.explanation: The distance between two opposite surfaces of something.

examples.english: The thickness of this book is 3 centimeters.
To measure the thickness of the wall.

notes:
{厚|あつ}さ is a measurement noun derived from the adjective ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) + the nominalizing suffix さ. It expresses thickness as a measurable quantity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {厚|あつ}さ〜⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧: ~ centimeters thick
- {厚|あつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure thickness
- {厚|あつ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have thickness, to be thick

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧ (heat/hotness from weather), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.

RELATED MEASUREMENT NOUNS:
- ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧: length (from ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧)
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: height (from ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧)
- ⟦{深|ふか}さ→深さ：05328_fukasa⟧: depth (from ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧: area/spaciousness (from ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧)
- ⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧: weight (from ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧)

All follow the same い-adjective stem + さ pattern to create nouns expressing degree or measurement.
